ENSIM students get to choose between two majors: Acoustics and instrumentation (A&I) or Computer sciences (Info). Halfway through the engineer course, they can further specialize by choosing one of two concentrations within each major: « Vibration, Acoustics » or « Sensors and Instrumentation for the Environment » for A&I; « Real-time Computing and Embedded Systems » or « Human–Computer Interactions » for Info. [...] ENSIM is an engineering school affiliated with the Réseau Polytech, conferring the title of « graduate engineer » accredited by the Cti (Commission des Titres d'ingénieurs) with the level of a master’s degree. # Le Mans Université – ENSIM

Located in Le Mans, a midsize city ranked in the top 10 of the most liveable cities in France, ENSIM (École Nationale Supérieure d’Ingénieurs du Mans) is a part of Le Mans University where 13 000 students (including 2 000 international students) are enrolled.

## Special features

This Master's degree provides a broad base of skills in mobile environments (development and security of nomadic systems, etc.) and modern software architectures (distributed application architectures, JavaEE, Spring, Big Data, etc.).

This common foundation is complemented by two new orientations, one focusing on performance and security, the other on data mining, and machine learning in particular. [...] Master the main software elements of an information system.
 Develop applications using design patterns and reusing proven solutions.
 Identify customer needs and translate them into specifications.
